role: Optional local frozen teacher; never used at Judge inference

reference_serving.placement: Same single H100 as student, loaded sequentially; no simultaneous residency required
reference_serving.status: Reference starting settings, not a measured engine configuration. Verify model support, memory and speed before freezing the runtime; no unverified engine version is promised.

editable_within_contract: which admitted ID training states receive assistance
per-request output cap and context length within hardware/time/token constraints
fixed: 2 million total teacher tokens including all retries, discarded text and reasoning
oracle remains the source of training labels

budget.measurement: Use the pinned teacher tokenizer; include rendered chat/special tokens actually submitted to the model and every generated token, including thinking, retries and rejected generations. Count reasoning once as part of generated output, not twice.
budget.cache_accounting: Repeated teacher input and reused outputs retain their attributable original cost; cached compute does not waive token accounting. Reused artifacts follow configs/baseline.json:reuse_cost_ledger.

suggested_use: Use deterministic builders for exact structured states and labels; spend optional teacher calls on selected difficult examples or explanations. Verify semantic answers with the oracle and count discarded calls. At 1000 total tokens per call, 2 million tokens permits only about 2000 such calls, not teacher coverage of 20000 training rows.
